title: Tau: a terminal coding agent built to be read, not just run

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Tao is a terminal coding agent you're actually meant to read, not just run. A working answer to how is a coding agent even built. Most agents are either a blackbox CLI or a giant production repo you can't learn anything from. This splits into three small layers you can read alone. One turns any provider into a neutral event stream. One is the portable brain of tools and loop. One wraps it as a real coding
